title: Video streaming pipeline
goal: Show live-video processing from ingest through adaptive delivery to a viewer.

rubric.must: A labelled input block Live Video Source is visibly shown.
The picture visibly shows a continuous ingest-to-viewer stream path.
control-plane links to encoder and CDN are visibly distinct from the primary flow.
All signal or energy connections visibly use directional arrowheads.
Input, control, processing, and output blocks are visibly differentiated by role or placement.
Connection labels identify the principal signal, energy, or data transformations.

ideal.notes: Refreshed against the September 15 exemplar: role fills, ink signal lines, 4 px block corners and restrained typography. Each target retains its own functional topology; generic blocks are not assigned inferred hardware roles.
